# victoriametricscloud_tiers (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available tiers for VictoriaMetrics Cloud deployments.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the results to a single deployment type. Valid values: 'single_node', 'cluster', 'vlogs_single' (VictoriaLogs), 'vtraces_single' (VictoriaTraces). Tiers of every type are returned when unset.

### Read-Only

- `tiers` (Attributes List) List of available tiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `access_token_concurrent_requests` (Number) Maximum concurrent requests per access token.
- `access_token_limit` (Number) Maximum number of access tokens for deployments of this tier.
- `active_time_series` (Number, Deprecated) Maximum number of active time series. Set for 'single_node' and 'cluster' tiers only.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider for this tier.
- `compute_cost_per_hour` (Number) Compute cost per hour in USD.
- `datapoints_read_rate` (Number, Deprecated) Maximum datapoints read rate. Set for 'single_node' and 'cluster' tiers only.
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the tier.
- `ingestion_rate` (Number, Deprecated) Maximum ingestion rate (samples per second). Set for 'single_node' and 'cluster' tiers only.
- `logs` (Attributes) Limits of a 'vlogs_single' tier. Null for other tier types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--logs))
- `metrics` (Attributes) Limits of a 'single_node' or 'cluster' tier. Null for other tier types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--metrics))
- `name` (String) Name of the tier.
- `new_series_over_24h` (Number, Deprecated) Maximum number of new series over 24 hours. Set for 'single_node' and 'cluster' tiers only.
- `series_read_per_query` (Number, Deprecated) Maximum series read per query. Set for 'single_node' and 'cluster' tiers only.
- `traces` (Attributes) Limits of a 'vtraces_single' tier. Null for other tier types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--traces))
- `type` (String) Type of deployment ('single_node', 'cluster', 'vlogs_single', or 'vtraces_single').

<a id="nestedatt--tiers--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers.logs`

Read-Only:

- `active_log_streams` (Number) Maximum number of active streams.
- `bytes_per_query` (Number) Maximum number of bytes scanned per query.
- `data_read_rate` (Number) Maximum read rate in bytes per second.
- `ingestion_rate_bytes` (Number) Maximum ingestion rate in bytes per second.
- `new_streams_over_24h` (Number) Maximum number of new streams over 24 hours.


<a id="nestedatt--tiers--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers.metrics`

Read-Only:

- `active_time_series` (Number) Maximum number of active time series.
- `datapoints_read_rate` (Number) Maximum datapoints read rate.
- `ingestion_rate` (Number) Maximum ingestion rate (samples per second).
- `new_series_over_24h` (Number) Maximum number of new series over 24 hours.
- `series_read_per_query` (Number) Maximum series read per query.


<a id="nestedatt--tiers--traces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers.traces`

Read-Only:

- `active_log_streams` (Number) Maximum number of active streams.
- `bytes_per_query` (Number) Maximum number of bytes scanned per query.
- `data_read_rate` (Number) Maximum read rate in bytes per second.
- `ingestion_rate_bytes` (Number) Maximum ingestion rate in bytes per second.
- `new_streams_over_24h` (Number) Maximum number of new streams over 24 hours.
